title: Prime-to-residue-characteristic uniformizer root extensions
statement: Let $R$ be a henselian discrete valuation ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field $F$, algebraically closed residue field $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] of characteristic $p>0$, and uniformizer $\pi$. For every positive integer $m$ prime to $p$, all roots in a separable closure of $F$ [def-pd-separable-closure] of $X^m-1$ belong to $R$. If $\alpha^m=\pi$ in that separable closure, then the splitting field $L$ of $X^m-\pi$ is $F(\alpha)$, is cyclic Galois of degree $m$ over $F$, and has ramification index $m$ at the unique maximal ideal of the integral closure of $R$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure].

source.place: Tag 0BUB (lemma-structure-decomposition-separable-closure), final proof paragraph: splitting field of X^m minus a uniformizer and divisibility of its ramification index; for the stated henselian specialization and equality, algebra.tex Tag 04GG (lemma-characterize-henselian, simple-root lifting) and the degree bound [F(alpha):F] <= m; more-algebra.tex Tag 09E8 (remark-finite-separable-extension), the degree/ramification formula giving e <= [L:F].
